_spec: docs/PRICEAI_PORTAL_NAV_SPEC.md §8.1 — machine-readable form of the reverse-proxy contract.
_rule: Longest prefix wins. Anything not matched by tokenbazaar.exact or tokenbazaar.prefixes goes to PriceAI.
_guard: frontend/src/router/__tests__/sameOriginRouteMap.spec.ts fails CI when TokenBazaar gains a top-level route that is not registered here.

/.why: Portal is the marketing front page (AGENTS.md). TokenBazaar's own / and /home redirect out to the portal in hub mode, so TB never needs to serve /.

/login.why: C-end login is TokenBazaar only. PriceAI's src/app/login/page.tsx becomes unreachable same-origin, which is intended — PA middleware already 307s to TB.

/api.why: PriceAI Next.js route handlers. Longest-prefix match keeps /api/v1 on TokenBazaar. Hard constraint: PriceAI must never add an /api/v1 prefix.

/admin.why: DECIDED 2026-07-31 (option A): PriceAI Admin moved to /pa-admin, so /admin is TokenBazaar's alone. No sub-path split — the CI guard stays at first-segment granularity.

notes.catchAll: TokenBazaar's /:pathMatch(.*)* 404 view is unreachable same-origin; unknown paths land on PriceAI's 404. Intended.
notes.storageNamespace: Audited 2026-07-30: zero collisions. TB localStorage keys (28) vs PriceAI's single 'priceai-theme'; TB cookies are all *_oauth_*, PriceAI's are all priceai_*. New keys on either side must carry a project-specific prefix.
